glucose.text: Glucose is a sugar used by the body for energy. This explanation does not interpret your result.

hemoglobin.text: Hemoglobin is a protein in red blood cells that transports oxygen. This explanation does not interpret your result.

ocr.text: OCR reads text from an image. Letters or numbers may have been read incorrectly.

reference_range.text: A reported range is the comparison interval printed in this report. No missing range has been supplied.

hematocrit.text: Hematocrit measures the proportion of red blood cells in the blood. This explanation does not interpret your result.

wbc.text: White blood cells (WBC) are immune cells that help defend the body against infection. This explanation does not interpret your result.

rbc.text: Red blood cells (RBC) carry oxygen from the lungs to tissues throughout the body. This explanation does not interpret your result.

platelets.text: Platelets are blood cell fragments involved in clotting. This explanation does not interpret your result.

creatinine.text: Creatinine is a waste product filtered from the blood by the kidneys. This explanation does not interpret your result.

sodium.text: Sodium is an electrolyte that helps regulate fluid balance and nerve/muscle function. This explanation does not interpret your result.

potassium.text: Potassium is an electrolyte essential for nerve signaling, muscle contraction, and heart rhythm. This explanation does not interpret your result.

chloride.text: Chloride is an electrolyte that helps maintain fluid and acid-base balance. This explanation does not interpret your result.

lab_measurement.text: Laboratory measurements report values printed in your medical document alongside the laboratory's reference interval when available. This explanation does not interpret your result.
